summary: The original Worker candidate matched its four target hashes and passed the existing 154/154 focused suite, but Controller targeted readback and adversarial replay rejected GREEN. A temporary dirty-main probe showed syncMainFfOnly returned clean:true while `git status --porcelain` was non-empty. A fake Git 9.99.9 producer was recorded as 2.54.0 and a deliberately false common_git_dir was accepted. Production inspectWorktree returned head/common_dir with no clean readback and Git gateway results were not Core GatewayResult wrappers. A deterministic Core probe showed DISPATCH persisted dispatch_roles/dispatch_scope/dispatch_validations outside exact CoordinatorStateV1, the first Agent action added no AGENT_RUN/REQUESTED event, and failed BLOCKED state persistence still returned a result claiming BLOCKED while durable state remained READY. These are retained final-review findings, not new architecture. Focused GREEN is withdrawn; the same Test role must add only the missing causal leaves before the original Worker resumes. No Standards or Spec Reviewer may start.
